authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Platts p. 444 explicitly gives Hindi candr-mā/candar-mā moon and analyses it as Sanskrit candra plus mās. The existing candramas parent preserves this full compound, distinct from candra alone. Retained ndr-m identifies the learned Sanskrit word in these Hindi attestations. Exact source form candrama is retained.
